$comment: Single source of truth for PostHog project 302298 ingestion (SCA-3665). Edit in a PR; scripts/check_posthog_config.py prints the cost; scripts/posthog/apply.py applies it after merge. PostHog is for product analytics only.

measured.method: HogQL per event: sum(100 / coalesce(omi_sample_pct, 100)) / 7; where a later looser stage overwrote the tag (Recording Upload Started/Completed: tagged 2, kept 0.5%), stored/day x 100 / effective pct. identified = person_mode full on at least half the rows. identified = person_mode other than propertyless (force_upgrade bills as identified), re-read 2026-11-23 ~12:00Z.

feature_flags.source: /api/billing/usage feature_flag_requests, team 302298: mean of 2026-11-16..22. All of it is project 302298. Billing counts the residual from older mobile builds; current mobile, desktop and web/app builds block /flags, and backend proactivity_flags made 0 PostHog calls in 7 days (GMP, ro-prod).
feature_flags.note: Update this from a fresh billing measurement; the estimate prices flags as measured_requests_per_day x days_per_month.

budget.source: PostHog price tiers (per unit); warehouse price derived from the 2026-11-23T07:44:58Z projection ($807.83 for 136.4M rows).
budget.tiers_note: Upper bounds in units per month; null is open-ended. The published 2-15M (events) and 2-10M (flags) rates are applied beyond their upper bound too, which overstates slightly.

waiver.reason: PostHog /flags requests from Android 1.0.573 (about 2,245 users) and other old builds cannot be cut without user-visible flag fallbacks; return to 500 when they upgrade (SCA-3665)

functions.name: Anonymous ingestion for ops events (cost cut 2026-10-17)
functions.note: Disabled. Setting $process_person_profile=false in a transformation does not make events anonymous for billing.

functions.name: Keep-list sampling: listed events pass, rest 2% (contracts/analytics/posthog.json)
events: Fact Page Create Fact Button Pressed
functions.note: Listed events skip the default sample; later sample stages still apply to them. $-events (except $rageclick) and names containing the hog-source markers also pass; that rule lives in the function source, not in inputs.

functions.name: Drop debug/ops events: route to the client collector (SCA-3665, David 2026-11-23)
Sample Recording Upload Failed at 2% (SCA-3665, David 2026-11-23)
Sample Capture Wedge Detected, Local WAL Stuck, Recording Start Failed at 2% (SCA-3665, David 2026-11-23)

schemas.name: gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_01B287_9348DC_02D256
schemas.note: Raw resource export, re-billed in full every 7 days. Replaced by gcp_cost_daily (David 2026-11-23); off by 2026-11-25T22:00Z.

schemas.name: gcp_cost_daily
schemas.note: Daily view gcp_billing_export.gcp_cost_daily (day x service, ~28 rows/day since 2026-04). Created by David and synced daily since 2026-11-24.

unmanaged.note: Marketing and finance sources, not managed by apply.py. Row estimate derived: 136.4M projected rows minus the raw GCP export (31.38M x 30/7).

Action Items Page Opened.sampled: 2% default since 2026-11-23. Readers are the presence check and saved insights last viewed 10-27 (xkycBQGR, nX4yHJZR, Ljh22BGA, cCyMigls); not in Omi TV qualified activity.

Apple Reminders Sync Completed.sampled: 2% default since 2026-11-23. Only reader is the per-build presence check, which needs one row; low-volume builds can read absent.

Battery Indicator Clicked.sampled: 2% default since 2026-11-23. Only reader is the per-build presence check, which needs one row; low-volume builds can read absent.

Device Session Ended.sampled: 2% by the keep-list default since 2026-11-23 (David). Readers weight by omi_sample_pct.

MCP Tool Use Succeeded.note: Off in the desired state (David, 2026-11-23). Live keeps it until the MCP Daily Activity rollup's first full UTC day matches the raw-row reader in wall-mcp; the release owner applies only then, and apply.py drift reports this one difference until that apply.

Memory Created.sampled: 2% by the keep-list default since 2026-11-23 (David). Readers weight by omi_sample_pct; per-actor qualified metrics count actors with foreground activity exactly and weight capture-only actors.

Recording Started.sampled: 2% by the keep-list default since 2026-11-23 (David). Readers weight by omi_sample_pct.

Rewind Screenshot Viewed.sampled: 2% default since 2026-11-23 (David: $660 waiver, weakest readers). Readers are saved insights last viewed 10-11 (xkycBQGR, nX4yHJZR) and 10-27 (Ljh22BGA); not in Omi TV qualified activity.

MCP Daily Activity.note: Server rollup (backend/utils/mcp_daily_rollup.py): cumulative snapshot per uid/client/UTC day at most once per 30 min, plus one after the day ends. Estimate is an upper bound from 7 days to 2026-11-23: 44,553 active 30-minute windows (6,365/day) plus 1,310 actor-client-days of final snapshots. Sent with $process_person_profile false, but uids with a person bill as identified.
